takes.action: In heavy rain under the floodlights the striker in green number 9 sprints at the ball, his face set hard in concentration, jaw tight, eyes locked on the ball, mouth closed; his white ORVO boots tear through wet turf, spraying grass and water. The camera races a hand's height above the pitch beside his boots.

From the ball's point of view on the penalty spot, his white ORVO boot plants hard beside the lens, studs sinking into the wet grass, his face clenched in concentration; his striking leg swings back and comes through, and the ball sits still on the spot right up to the moment his instep meets it. The camera stays low at the ball.

The same shot runs on without a break: his instep drives through the ball, the knit flexing, and the ball blasts off the boot out of frame toward the goal as rainwater explodes off the leather and his body twists through the strike. Low angle, floodlight streaks.

The camera flies with the ball toward the goal, spinning slightly; his boot falls away in follow-through below, and ahead the goalkeeper in black dives full length, too late, as the ball beats his glove and bulges the net. When the striker runs into view, his plain green shirt carries only a big white 9 on the back.

He slides toward the lens on his knees across the soaked grass, arms flung wide, shouting with joy, water fanning off his white ORVO boots while the crowd jumps up behind. The camera tracks backward low over the turf.
PACKSHOT: one white ORVO boot stands on the wet penalty spot beside the ball, raindrops running down the knit, rain falling through the floodlight beams. The camera drifts slowly in and settles.
